sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme "Tution Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category)" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000/- annually to unreserved category students in the science stream of Class 11th and 12th.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Education and training grants, fellowship, stipend

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Tution Sahay Yojana (Unreserved Category)&quot; by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Gujarat aims to support meritorious students from the unreserved category pursuing science in Classes 11 and 12 by providing them annual tuition fee assistance. This scheme ensures that students who scored 70% or more in their Class 10 board examination receive ₹15,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to pursue science education. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Unreserved Educational &amp; Economic Development Corporation.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Monetary Assistance:** ₹15,000/- per academic year is provided as tuition assistance to each eligible student.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Go to the Corporation's [official website](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/) and navigate to the "Gujarat Unreserved Education and Economical Development Corporation" section under the Corporation menu. **Step 2:**Click on "Tuition Sahay Yojana" and then Apply Now. **Step 3:** Click on "New User? Please Register Here". **Step 4:** Enter the required details and click Register. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Enter your User ID, Password, and Captcha Code, then click "Login". **Step 2:** Read the scheme details carefully and click OK. **Step 3:** If your permanent address is correct, confirm it. Otherwise, enter your correct address. **Step 4:** Click Save & Next to proceed. Upload the relevant documents. **Step 5:** If you need to make changes, click "No, Cancel". If all details are correct, click "Yes, Submit". **Step 6:** Click Save Application. Note down your Application Number for future reference. You can also take a printout by clicking Print Application. > **Check Application Status:** [Click here](https://esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in/ViewApplicationStatus.aspx). > **Post Online Application Procedure:** After submitting the online application, the applicant must take a printout of the application, sign it, and submit it along with all uploaded documents (certificates, mark sheets, etc.) to the concerned Deputy Director (Non-Reserved Category) or the District Social Welfare Officer through courier, post, or by visiting in person. > **Contact Us:** [Click here](https://gueedc.gujarat.gov.in/contact-us.html).
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Ujarat Unreserved Educational & Economic Development Corporation; Nodal Department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department
**Tags:** Unreserved Category, Science, Tuition Fee Assistance, Education
